paite: Aaron tapate pawl khendan hichibang ahi, Aaron tapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
heading: Siampute Nagotna
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu bel apa uh sang in asi masa ua; ta anei kei uh; huaiziak in Eleazar leh Ithamarte'n siampu nna asem uhi.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

paite: David in Eleazar tapa Zadok leh Ithamar tapa Ahimelekte toh anasepdan ding uh ahawmsak hi.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

paite: Ithamar suante sang in Eleazar suan makaipen a pang atamzaw uh; hichibang in akhen ua; Eleazar suan ah, inkuan makaipen sawm-le-guk a hi uh; Ithamar suan ah, inkuan makaipen giat ahi uhi.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

paite: Eleazar suan a mi leh Ithamar suan a mite lak ah, mun siangthou a miliante leh Pathian miliante a om tuaktuak uh ahih ziak in aisan in, amaute akhen uhi.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

paite: Huan Levi mi, laigelhmi Nethaneel tapa Shemaiah in kumpipa, milian, siampu Zadok, Abiathar tapa Ahimelek, siampute leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in agelh a; inkuan pipa khat tan Eleazar tung ah apuk a, khat bel Ithamar tung ah apuk hi.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

paite: Huchi in aisan akhatveina bel Jehoarib tung ah atu a, anihveina Jedaiah tung ah;
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

paite: athumveina Harim tung ah, aliveina Seorim tung ah;
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

paite: angaveina Makijah tung ah, agukveina Mijamin tung ah;
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

paite: asagihveina Hakoz tung ah, agiatveina Abijah tung ah;
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

paite: akuaveina Jeshua tung ah, asawmveina Shekaniah tung ah;
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

paite: asawm-le-khatveina Eliashib tung ah, asawm-le-nihveina Jakim tung ah;
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

paite: asawm-le-thumveina Huppah tung ah, asawm-le-liveina Jeshebeab tung ah;
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

paite: asawm-le-ngaveina Bilgah tung ah, asawm-le-gukveina Immer tung ah;
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

paite: asawm-le-sagihveina Hezir tung ah, asawm-le-giatveina Happizzez tung ah;
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

paite: asawm-le-kuaveina Pethahiah tung ah, asawmnihveina Jehezekel tung ah;
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

paite: asawmnih-le-khatveina Jakin tung ah, asawmnih-le-nihveina Gamul tung ah;
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

paite: asawmnih-le-thumveina Delaiah tung ah, asawmnih-le-liveina Maaziah tung ah atu hi.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

paite: Huai bel TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in apu uh Aaron thu ana piak, TOUPA insung a nna asepdan ding ana sehdan ahi hi.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

paite: Levi suan dangte lak ah; Amram tapate lak ah Shubael ahi; Shubael tapate lak ah Jehdeiah.
heading: Levite Mite Phakzah
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

paite: Rehabiah lam ah; Rehabaihte lak ah amakaipen Isshiah ahi.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

paite: Izharte lak ah Shelomoth; Shelomoth tapate lak ah Jahath,
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

paite: Hebron tapate, a-upapen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jokameam ahi.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

paite: Uzziel tapate lak a mi Mikah; Mikah tapate lak a mi Shamir ahi.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

paite: Mikah unaupa Isshiah ahi a; Isshiah tapate lak a mi Zekariah ahi.
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

paite: Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi ua; Jaaziah tapate lak a mi Beno ahi.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

paite: Merari suante, Jaaziah lak ah Beno, Shoham, Zakkur leh Ibrite ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

paite: Mahli lak ah, Eleazar ahi a, ama'n tapa anei kei.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

paite: Kish lak ah, Kish tapa Jerahmeel ahi.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

paite: Mushi suante bel, Mahli, Eder leh Jerimothte ahi uh. Hiaite bel Levite suante lak a a-inkuan ua makai lianpente ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

paite: Hiai inkuan chih a lianpen leh naupangpente'n leng Aaron ta a-unaute uh bang in, agam tan ding uh, kumpipa David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampu leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in ai asan sam uhi.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
